reported.title: Beacon not forced OFF promptly on quiet hold
reported.description: The quiet check at line 52 reads D3 every loop with no debounce, so short LOW glitches are treated as a hold and drive setBeacon(false) at line 58. Because lastSlice is reset to nowSlice at line 59 on every quiet loop, the blink phase restarts from the release instant, delaying the next HIGH. Measured: D12 was not HIGH for 145 ms while required (grace 100 ms) starting at 100 ms, wrong state for 3579 ms across 21 intervals. D12 was in the wrong state for 3579 ms across 21 interval(s), first at 100 ms: D12 was not HIGH for 145 ms while required (grace 100 ms).

reported.title: Tick period far shorter than 1000 ms
reported.description: The blink interval is compared as (uint8_t)(nowSlice - lastSlice) >= HALF_MS at line 61, where HALF_MS is 500, so the beacon toggles every 500 ms and emitTick fires on each rising edge at line 68, producing ticks every ~500 ms instead of 1000 ms. Measured: 18 of 19 intervals out of tolerance, worst gap 489 ms. Expected /^tick$/ every 1000 ± 120 ms; 18 of 19 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 489 ms.

reported.title: Excessive beacon toggling in 2000 ms window
reported.description: The 500 ms half-period at line 61 combined with undebounced quiet reads at line 52 causes extra setBeacon(false) calls at line 58 and rapid re-toggles, exceeding the 5-toggle limit. Measured: D12 toggled 8 times in a 2000 ms window starting at 245 ms (limit 5), and 16 times over the whole 8.00 s run. D12 toggled 8 times in a 2000 ms window starting at 245 ms (limit 5), and 16 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

truth.description: byte HALF_MS truncates 500 to 244 so blink period is too short

judge_input.spec:
- Nav beacon LED on D12; quiet hold switch on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Blink D12 with 500 ms HIGH and 500 ms LOW while quiet is released, forever.
- Print the exact line `tick` on each rising edge of the beacon (once per 1000 ms ±120 ms).
- While D3 is held LOW, force the beacon OFF and pause the blink schedule.
- Beacon must not change state more than 5 times in any 2000 ms window during free blink.
- Every 2000 ms print `nav rises=<n> quiet=<0|1>` for operator telemetry.
